svg.aria-label: CFT three circles: Three circles (CFT) — full showcase. Systems — Threat (protect; over-developed): inner critic, anxiety, anger; Drive (pursue; over-developed): striving, achieving, wanting more; Soothing (rest & connect; depleted): self-kindness, safeness, connection. Grow the soothing system to balance threat and drive.

svg.text: Three systems (Gilbert): grow the soothing system — it balances threat and drive.
This map supports, and does not replace, professional care. The three-systems model is a useful simplification, not a brain map.
